title: Mar 6 decision-bar vendor diagnosis
question: Which vendor's bar is wrong for the 2026-03-06 15:00 UTC 5-minute MNQ decision bar?

classification_rule.DATABENTO_SIDE: wrong contract, shifted timestamp, bad bar, or adapter bug
classification_rule.REFERENCE_DEFECT: Databento MNQH6 1m rebuilds its 5m bar consistently and Polygon/Oct4 is the odd one out
classification_rule.UNEXPLAINED: evidence mixed or cause not isolated
classification_rule.why: The five MNQH6 1-minute bars at 15:00-15:04 UTC aggregate exactly to the committed Databento 5m bar (O/H/L/C/volume). The last 1m close equals the 5m close. Every aligned 5m bar from 14:30 through 15:30 UTC also rebuilds exactly from MNQH6 1m. The adapter at 7fdc9252 selects MNQH6 that day (roll_days=8; third Friday 2026-03-20; roll window starts 2026-03-12) and uses UTC bar-start timestamps. No other contract (MNQM6, MNQU6, or the MNQH6-MNQM6 spread) and no shifted 1-5 minute window reproduces either the Databento 5m bar or the Polygon/Oct4 bar. Polygon/Oct4 OHLC is not any prefix of the MNQH6 1m series. The transition-export Polygon 5m file then has a 50-minute hole (missing 15:05 through 15:50) after a thin 15:00 bar (volume 7616 vs Databento 51008).

decoder.method: local DBNStore decode of a byte-identical tmp copy of the parent ohlcv-1m DBN; definitions used only to map instrument_id -> raw_symbol

ioc.note: Both closes are beyond the 32-tick IOC cap, so both vendors are NO_FILL. That matching outcome is not evidence the bars agree.

adapter.head: 7fdc9252f1d74903eab2e0a8ebfac9154e3d2aae
adapter.date_basis: civil ET date of the bar-start timestamp (15:00 UTC = 10:00 EST on 2026-03-06)
adapter.aggregation: open=first 1m open; high=max; low=min; close=last 1m close; volume=sum; never synthesize a missing minute
code_refs: research/databento_322_bar_adapter.py:452-474 _select_bars filters to that instrument_id using civil ET date
sources/polygon_client.py:62-86 front_contract; rolls when on_date >= third_friday - 8

window_search.description: For every instrument present in 14:25-15:35 UTC, every clock-contiguous window of 1, 2, 3, 4, or 5 minutes was aggregated (start-label) and compared to both target bars. Named end-label windows 14:56-15:00 and 15:01-15:05 were also checked.
window_search.only_match: MNQH6 15:00-15:04 start-label equals the committed Databento 5m OHLCV

only_1m_close_at_24764.5.note: This is the last minute of the decision window, as required for a consistent 5m close.

MNQM6.note: About +220 points above MNQH6 (calendar back month); volume 246 vs MNQH6 51008.

MNQU6.note: Sparse back-month prints around 25200; only two of five minutes present (15:02 and 15:03), total volume 2.

MNQH6-MNQM6.note: Calendar spread; no prints in 15:00-15:04. Two prints in the wider window at 212.9 and 214.5.

polygon_vs_databento_in_window.14:30_through_14:50: OHLCV identical on all five bars
polygon_vs_databento_in_window.14:55: OHL identical; Polygon close 24691.5 vs Databento 24691.0 (+0.50); volume 32588 vs 32586 (+2). Same last-print pattern as the 2024-09-06 and 2026-06-11 IOC mismatch days.
polygon_vs_databento_in_window.15:00: material disagreement: open +0.50 (Polygon 24692.0 vs 24691.5), high -23.00 (24754.75 vs 24777.75), low identical 24687.75, close -13.00 (24751.5 vs 24764.5), volume 7616 vs 51008

first_mnqh6_1m_vs_polygon_15_00.note: Polygon volume 7616 is less than the first MNQH6 1m volume 18917. Polygon high 24754.75 is below the first 1m high 24773.75. Polygon close 24751.5 is not the first 1m close 24738.25. No 1-5 minute prefix of MNQH6 from 15:00 aggregates to the Polygon OHLC. This is not a complete-minute truncation of the Databento series.

polygon_context_14_30_to_15_30.resume_bar_15_55_note: The next shared timestamp after the hole also disagrees materially: Polygon 15:55 O 24873.0 H 24884.5 L 24851.5 C 24858.5 V 16957 vs Databento O 24790.0 L 24790.0 V 40852 (open +83.0, low +61.5, volume -23895). That bar is outside the requested 14:30-15:30 window and was not used for classification; it is recorded as context that the hole is bookended by two disagreeing Polygon bars.
polygon_context_14_30_to_15_30.day_wide_note: Across the 254 timestamps present in both files, 32 disagree. Most are last-print style close deltas of ±0.25 or ±0.50 (and a few neighboring volume hand-offs). The only material OHL disagreements on 2026-03-06 are 15:00 and 15:55.

caveats: The official pinned Polygon 5m tree 7f09a7f8 is not on this box. Reference OHLC comes from the Oct 4 ledger (sha 0d0d8d72…) and the transition-export Polygon 5m copy, whose 15:00 bar matches that ledger exactly. The 50-minute hole (15:05-15:50) is observed in that export copy; the official tree was not compared.

No Polygon 1-minute bars were decoded, so the exact construction of the thin Polygon 15:00 bar is not recovered. It is enough that no Databento 1m combination reproduces it and that Databento MNQH6 1m rebuilds its own 5m bar.
Existing BAR_EVIDENCE.md and BAR_EVIDENCE.json were not modified.
